name: TnC
summary: Shopify app that puts a mandatory “I agree to the terms” checkbox on the cart and on the Buy It Now, PayPal and Apple Pay express buttons, logs the consent timestamp against the order, and can show it only for chosen products or countries for GDPR and age gates.
best_for: Shopify merchants on a standard plan who need a recorded “I agree” gate before payment (for GDPR, an age gate, digital-goods withdrawal rules or chargeback defence) and who go to Advanced at $9.99 for the consent timestamp rather than stopping at the $4.99 headline
skip_if: you are on Shopify Plus and want the checkbox inside the real checkout page, where the plan you need is the $19.99 Plus tier the App Store listing does not show; you expected a free tier from the listing's badge, which covers development and partner stores only; or a checkbox on the cart and the express buttons is not the enforcement your legal requirement actually asks for
honest_knock:
Start with the badge at the top of the listing, because it is the one thing on this page that misleads. “Free plan available” is displayed twice, and the free plan is Development Stores: for development and partner stores only, with payment activated on upgrade. A store that takes real orders has no free tier here, and in our own test session on 17 November 2026 the app did not offer even that plan on a Shopify development store: its first screen asked us to pick a paid plan to start the 7 day free trial. It is the same shape as this developer's Blocky and TiXel listings, where the advertised free plan is also development stores rather than a working free tier, so read it as a house pattern rather than an oversight.

Second, the App Store's pricing table is incomplete. The vendor's own help-centre article lists a Plus Plan at $19.99 a month, Shopify Plus only, and describes it as the plan that shows the checkbox in the actual checkout page. The App Store listing shows four plans and not that one. The same article answers its own hidden-fees question with “No. All pricing is transparent and listed above”, which is true of that article and not of the listing most buyers will read first. If you are on Plus and you want consent captured in checkout rather than in the cart, the price is four times the $4.99 headline.

Third, the feature that makes the app defensible costs extra, and what it costs is not stable. Basic at $4.99 shows the checkbox; it does not record when anyone ticked it. Consent date logging starts on Advanced at $9.99. Across our readings the step from checkbox to audit trail has been $3, then $5, then $4, and is now $5 again (listing, read 17 November 2026), with identical feature lists every time and no note on the listing about any of the changes. For an app whose pitch is chargebacks and legal risk, an audit trail as a paid upgrade is worth knowing before you compare $4.99 against anything else.

Fourth, be clear about what this can and cannot enforce. On a store that is not on Shopify Plus the checkbox lives in the cart and on express-checkout buttons, not inside Shopify's checkout, because Shopify does not open that page to apps below Plus. The listing is honest about the surfaces it does cover (cart drawers, Buy It Now, express checkout buttons, floating carts, PayPal and Apple Pay) but a shopper who reaches payment by another route has not passed a gate. Whether that is sufficient consent is a question for your own counsel rather than for an app listing.

Finally, the data access. The listing states the app views device and activity data including geolocation, IP address, browser and operating system and browsing behaviour, and can view and edit customers, products, orders for the last 60 days, store analytics, web pixels and the Online Store script tags and theme. Geolocation is what the country targeting on Advanced and above runs on, so the scope is explicable, but an app installed for compliance reasons that itself processes IP addresses and browsing behaviour belongs in the same register as everything else you had to write down.

pricing.notes:
(read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/terms-and-conditions-checkbox and in our own test session on 17 November 2026) Basic is $4.99 a month ($47.90 a year), Advanced $9.99 ($83.92) and Pro $14.99 ($89.94), each with a 7 day free trial. The listing, which now calls the app “TN Term and Condition Checkbox”, puts the annual saving at 20% on Basic, 30% on Advanced and 50% on Pro.

In the app, which the Shopify admin calls “TnC Terms Checkbox”, the plan screen in our own test session on 17 November 2026 showed the same monthly prices and, with the yearly toggle on, the listing's annual prices spread over twelve months and billed annually. It showed no free plan: on a Shopify development store the first screen asked us to pick a paid plan to start the 7 day free trial, and the approval screen for Basic asked for a payment method.

This ladder has changed four times since August 2026, each time with the same feature lists. Treat any figure here, ours included, as the price on the day it was read, and check the listing before you install.

Four plans on the listing, and the free one is not for you. Development Stores is free and carries every Pro feature, but the listing states it is for development and partner stores only and that payment will be activated on upgrade, so the “Free plan available” line at the top of the listing describes a partner sandbox rather than a free tier for a store that takes orders, and in our test the app did not offer it on a development store either. Basic covers the AI terms and conditions checkbox, Buy It Now and express checkout buttons, the checkbox in the cart and cart drawer, and age verification and GDPR consent text. Advanced adds the consent date and time logged on each order and checkout rules by product and country. Pro adds newsletter, signup and contact form boxes, a multilingual checkbox for every market, the checkbox in Shopify POS and an AI terms and policies generator. The listing states charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days.

The vendor's own pricing article, updated 12 November 2026 and read 17 November 2026, prints the same monthly and annual rates as the listing for all three plans and puts the annual saving at up to 50%. It still answers its own question “are there any hidden fees?” with “No. All pricing is transparent and listed above”. It is also the only page where a fifth plan appears at all: a Plus Plan at $19.99 a month or $167.92 a year, for Shopify Plus merchants only, which the article has described since September as the plan that shows the checkbox in the actual checkout page. The Plus Plan is the one rate that has not moved in any of our readings, so it now sits $5 above Pro. On 29 September 2026 the article also noted that uninstalling during an ongoing billing period still incurs that period's charge.

Developer Effective Apps, trading as Effectify, at 13 Max Nordau, Ashdod, Israel; the app launched on 2 December 2019, carries Shopify's Built for Shopify badge, and stood at 570 listing reviews with a 4.9 average on 17 November 2026, up from 565 on 14 October and 550 on 9 September.
